label: Gateway Disposition
description: Gateway-authority disposition node. Two input tiers: artifact_in (non-authority, accepts model proposals for extraction/scope-check) and approved_artifact (authority, forbids proposals — only pre-disposed artifacts may enter). Emits disposed_artifact (untagged), which is safe to wire into any downstream authority input. This is the primary disposal step that converts a model proposal into an authority-safe artifact.

inputs.name: artifact_in
inputs.description: Non-authority input. Receives the model-proposed artifact for scope checking and extraction. No tag constraint — model proposals may enter here. The gateway validates scope, extracts the artifact, and emits disposed_artifact.

inputs.name: approved_artifact
inputs.description: Authority input. Receives a pre-approved, non-proposal artifact (e.g. from a prior disposal step). Forbids proposal-tagged values — model outputs must never wire here directly.

outputs.name: disposed_artifact
outputs.description: Script/gateway-disposed artifact. No proposal tag — safe to wire into authority inputs of oracle_check, human_freeze_gate, or any downstream authority state.

outputs.name: scope_passed
outputs.description: True if scope validation passed (scope_subset_allowed guard).
